result.summary: Switches `contrib/guix/guix-build` from exporting the `GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH` environment variable to passing `--load-path` directly to `guix shell`. This ensures local modules are scoped only to the pinned Guix invocation.
result.problem: Exporting `GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH` globally during the Guix build leaks local package modules outside the pinned Guix execution, causing Guix build failures on master (#36530).
evidence: Fixes #36530, titled 'Guix build failure on master (f13ae519de94394314cd63a27924b0998ac65d45)'
Code comment in diff explains the rationale: 'passed to `guix shell` via --load-path, rather than exported via GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH, so they are only seen by the pinned Guix.'
result.changed_since_previous: The previous assessment framed the change as a minor build cleanup; this update connects the change to fixing an active Guix build failure on master (#36530).
result.card: This PR updates contrib/guix/guix-build to pass local package modules to guix shell via --load-path instead of exporting GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH globally. This prevents module definitions from leaking outside the pinned Guix invocation, resolving a Guix build failure on master. Evidence of importance is that it fixes issue #36530 reporting a broken Guix build on master. It has no dependencies.

risk.why: A flaw in Guix build script configuration could break release binary builds or deterministic Guix reproducibility.
